## Highlights

- MSc dissertation: AI-integrated digital twin for an automotive Tier 1 export supply chain — GRU neural-network demand forecasting + NSGA-II multi-objective optimisation, human-in-the-loop; full Python pipeline on 500+ real order records across SCOR blocks; 98.5% baseline delivery performance; Pareto-front trade-off analysis.
- Design Lead at Green Tech Innovation (GTI): founded the Speed Prototyping team for the XPRIZE Wildfire entry; four flying proof-of-concept drones; technical excellence award at ExpoIngenierías Tec de Monterrey.
- Engineering intern at Magna CIMS (Tier 1 automotive): validated a 3D-scanning / photogrammetry proof of concept for in-plant quality control.
- Research assistant at CINVESTAV: RGB-D and point-cloud vision for robotic perception.
- 2× World Championship qualifier: VEX U (programmer & electrician) and FIRST Robotics Competition (programming & electrical mentor, Team Blue Ignition).
- Learned German to B2 in six months, then taught it.

## Projects (27)

### Data & Supply Chain

- AI-Integrated Digital Twin for an Automotive Export Supply Chain — MSc Dissertation (2026, University of Hull, UK): GRU demand forecasting + NSGA-II multi-objective optimisation on 500+ real export orders, under a human-in-the-loop framework.
- NHS Organ Donation — Power BI Analysis (2026, University of Hull — NHSBT coursework): 5-page Power BI report treating organs as the ultimate last-mile logistics problem — 10 years of NHSBT data, cold-chain CIT risk included.
- Supply Chain Analytics Dashboard — Power BI (Programmatic PBIR) (2026, University of Hull, UK): End-to-end supply chain performance dashboard with the data model and report built programmatically in PBIR / JSON.
- Import Strategy — Maize Flour into a UK Retail Distribution Centre (2026, University of Hull, UK): End-to-end import strategy into Tesco's Humber DC: sourcing, international routing and UK import compliance.

### Industry & Research

- 3D Scanning Rig Prototype for Quality Control – Magna CIMS (Apr – Jun 2025, Ramos Arizpe, MX): Point-cloud scanning rig that makes geometric inspection faster and more accessible on a Tier 1 automotive production floor.
- RGB-D & Point Cloud Vision Systems – Research at CINVESTAV (Feb – Mar 2025, Ramos Arizpe, MX): Computer-vision research on depth data and spatial reconstruction for robotic perception and scene understanding.
- Team Romeo – Wildfire-Response Drones, Design Lead (GTI / XPRIZE) (Jun 2024 – Aug 2025, Saltillo · Monterrey, MX): Founded and led GTI's Speed Prototyping team: four flying proof-of-concept drones for the XPRIZE Wildfire entry.
- Automated Gripper Design for KUKA Robotic Arm – GecVac (Sep – Dec 2024, Saltillo, MX): Conceptual and functional gripper prototype for a KUKA arm — simulated in KUKA.Sim, built with additive manufacturing.
- Automated Transport Cart Concept for Polsa (Aug 2024, Saltillo, MX): SolidWorks-designed automated cart in PTR steel, driven by a Raspberry Pi Pico through gears and chains.
